obs = observe()
mug = obs["objects"]["green_mug"]
cyan_tray = obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]

occupied = False
for obj in obs["objects"].values():
    if obj["center"][0] < cyan_tray["center"][0] + cyan_tray["half_size"][0] and \
       obj["center"][0] > cyan_tray["center"][0] - cyan_tray["half_size"][0] and \
       obj["center"][1] < cyan_tray["center"][1] + cyan_tray["half_size"][1] and \
       obj["center"][1] > cyan_tray["center"][1] - cyan_tray["half_size"][1] and \
       obj["center"][2] < cyan_tray["center"][2] + 0.01:  # Slight tolerance for z
        occupied = True
        break

if occupied:
    # Move occupying object to orange_tray
    for obj in obs["objects"].values():
        if (obj["center"][0] < cyan_tray["center"][0] + cyan_tray["half_size"][0] and
            obj["center"][0] > cyan_tray["center"][0] - cyan_tray["half_size"][0] and
            obj["center"][1] < cyan_tray["center"][1] + cyan_tray["half_size"][1] and
            obj["center"][1] > cyan_tray["center"][1] - cyan_tray["half_size"][1] and
            obj["center"][2] < cyan_tray["center"][2] + 0.01):
            # Move to orange_tray
            move_to(obj["center"][0], obj["center"][1], 1.0)
            move_to(obj["center"][0], obj["center"][1], obj["top_z"] + 0.05)
